change_note: Adds election_administration - surfaced by the Step 2 pilot, where two polling-day process articles had no conformant issue code (the code existed in the event-type enum but not the issue taxonomy). Purely additive; records stamped issues-v1.1 remain valid and traceable, and validation rule R9 prevents the new code from appearing under the old stamp.

codes.planning_housing: planning decisions, housing development, green belt building
codes.local_business: local economy, high streets, business support
codes.immigration: immigration and asylum policy or local impact
codes.council_performance: competence and delivery of the council
codes.service_closure: closure or reduction of public services
codes.local_government_reorganisation: unitary reorganisation, boundary and structure changes
codes.new_party_emergence: emergence or rise of a new party
codes.election_administration: NEW in v1.2: election process and administration - polling arrangements, voting procedures, counting arrangements, election administration issues
